_about: The app's own interface words that exist only on screen, not in any file it writes. Each was read from the named frame in the capture's screenshots/ folder (2560 x 1600 originals); where the frame was ambiguous about a character, the note says how it was settled. tools/demo/build_demo.py copies these into demo.json's app area, checks each frame exists in the capture, and cross-checks the counts inside them against the data. The Checked tooltip is deliberately absent: it names the checking model.

date.note: Also the Accessibility value in logs/ask-ax-dumps/q01.dump.txt.

traced.text: All 11 claims traced to the recording

checked.note: One mark for the whole summary, top right. Its tooltip is not used.

setAsideHeading.note: Read from the frame, never published from it: 01d also shows the provenance card.

setAsideLine.text: Written by the AI, but the check model found that the transcript lines it worked from don't say this. Read it as a lead, not a finding.
setAsideLine.note: The apostrophe in don't is straight, checked at 4x zoom.

askPlaceholder.note: One ellipsis character, per the Accessibility placeholder in logs/ask-ax-dumps/q01.dump.txt.

askRefusal.text: I found nothing in this meeting that says that.

askFootnote.text: 1 shown in the transcript's own words: the check model would not support the wording.
askFootnote.note: Also the Accessibility value in logs/ask-ax-dumps/q08.dump.txt; the apostrophe is straight.
